findings.finding: Q2 2026's $102M Japan sales (+55% q/q) included about $25M of one-time benefit from a change in the wholesaler distribution model (argenx Q2 slides). Japan therefore faces a ~$25M harder q/q comp in Q3, about 1.5% of a ~$1.65-1.70B Q3 bar, if any model extrapolated Q2 Japan or Q2's +17% total q/q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: argenx trades on total product net sales. Revenue beats of 6-17% bought +8.6% (Q2'26) and +11.9% (Q2'25). Beats of 1.5-4.7% got -5.6% and -0.2%. The Q1'26 miss of about 9% got -2.5% (closes from Yahoo v8 chart, release dates from EDGAR 6-K list). No history on the Japan line alone.
findings.why_not_priced: It was disclosed on the slide, so most models should have stripped it. If they had not, the Q3 EPS range would not run as wide as $6.51-$8.95. The size stays small because it is a $25M item in a ~$1.7B quarter, and the US (84% of sales, +15% q/q in Q2) decides the print.

findings.finding: J&J's 'Other Immunology' US sales, mostly IMAAVY (nipocalimab, the competing FcRn blocker in gMG), rose from $38M in Q1 to $85M in Q2 and $126M in Q3 2026 (+48% q/q, +$41M). Worldwide Q3 was $147M (J&J Q3 8-K, 2026-10-13). J&J reported this after argenx last spoke on sales. It is a direct competitor's Q3 number in VYVGART's core indication, against VYVGART's Q2 US sales of $1,273M (+$166M q/q).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior argenx reaction tied to a competitor's sales line. US sales are the line the stock trades on (see total-sales reactions above).
findings.why_not_priced: J&J does not break out IMAAVY by name. It sits in an unlabelled 'Other Immunology' line in the supplementary schedule, and the press release only says 'new products within Other in Immunology'. If the market had read it as share loss, ARGX would not have rallied +7.7% over the last five sessions, which include the 10-13 release. Kept small: J&J's +$41M q/q is a quarter of argenx's last US q/q gain, the line may hold other products, and a growing FcRn class can lift VYVGART too. To hurt the print, the rest of VYVGART US (seronegative label, prefilled syringe, CIDP) would have to slow at the same time.
findings.independence: J&J Q2 2026 exhibit gives the Q2 base of US $85M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040626000146/a2026q2exhibit992.htm). It is the same company's series, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is VYVGART's first full quarter with the US seronegative gMG label (PDUFA 2026-05-10, approved; Q2 slides: '+11k patients now eligible in the U.S.'). In Q2 the prefilled syringe brought ~80% of its patients new to VYVGART, and US sales grew +15% q/q. The derived consensus asks only about +10-13% q/q on underlying Q2 ($1,491M ex the Japan one-off) to reach ~$1.65-1.70B.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two quarters with revenue beats above 6% (Q2'25 +16.5% vs est, Q2'26 +6.2%) moved +11.9% and +8.6%. Smaller beats were sold (Q4'25 -5.6%, Q3'25 -0.2%). So this name pays only for a large total-sales beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The FY $6.3B consensus already implies strong H2 growth, and the label and syringe are public. The only edge is that the bar rests on 3-4 estimates and implies a slower q/q rate than Q2's US +15%. If the market expected a big beat, the skew would be call-rich and the stock would not sit 17% under its high with a 25-analyst average target of $1,153. Inference from momentum, not a company Q3 number, so capped.
findings.independence: FB25 release shows the seronegative PDUFA date of 2026-05-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1697862/000169786226000010/a09earningspressreleaseq4.htm). Same company, different document. The J&J finding above points the other way.

findings.finding: The Q3 call is management's first Q&A since the 2026-10-08 twin release: Phase 3 UNITY (efgartigimod SC in Sjogren's) stopped for futility at interim, originally due 2H27, and FB102 Phase 2 celiac succeeded (p=0.0176), moving to Phase 3. ARGX fell 11.8% that day on 9x volume. The 2026 milestone list leaves two registrational readouts guided to Q4 2026 that could be updated or pulled forward in the release: EMPASSION (empasiprubart, MMN) and ADVANCE-NEXT (primary ITP).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pipeline news has moved this stock more than sales: ALKIVIA topline +16.0% (2026-08-17), UNITY futility/FB102 -11.8% (2026-10-08), Forte deal -3.2% (2026-07-27).
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the timing nor the content of any update is known, so there is no sign to price. Sized at 0, with a wide band that is the real risk on this print. If the market expected an EMPASSION readout with the release, the Nov-20 straddle would carry a visible event premium, and it does not (implied 10.4% over 30 days, below realised).
findings.independence: FY25 release milestone list (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1697862/000169786226000010/a09earningspressreleaseq4.htm) and Q2 release, both from the company. The FB102 celiac release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1697862/000110465926114491/tm2627263d1_ex99-1.htm) shares the 10-08 6-K.

findings.finding: The Forte Biosciences acquisition closed 2026-08-27, inside Q3: ~$2.2B equity value, $77/share, all cash on hand, 87.13% tendered. Q3 cash will therefore fall from the $5.2B reported at 2026-06-30, and the accounting of acquired FB102 (capitalised intangible vs expensed) decides whether Q3 EPS lands near the low ($6.51) or the high ($8.95) of the 3-analyst range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4'25 beat EPS by $1.97 on in-line revenue and fell 5.6%, and Q1'26 missed EPS by $0.22 and fell 2.5%. The stock follows sales, not EPS.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and cash-funded, with no path to sales or guidance, so it is worth a fraction of operating dollars. Financing question answered: the money buys a pipeline asset (FB102), and there is no balance-sheet stress at $5.2B. Filed so judges can discount a headline EPS beat or miss on this item.

baseline_tension: Nothing found cuts against the balanced skew (-0.87) or the 5-day +7.7% rebound. The small negatives (Japan comp, J&J IMAAVY growth) and the small positive (first full seronegative quarter) offset, so the evidence leaves the market's balanced stance intact.
